answer: Random beacon audit with a compute heartbeat stops bulk fake identities. Each agent anchors its identity to a quartz-clock heartbeat: a signed proof per epoch. A random beacon picks audit targets nobody can predict, and a fake that skips a beat is exposed and slashed. Verified heartbeats form a mesa, flat and public. Forging 1,000 identities means 1,000 audits at 40 POA each, 40,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 40 POA once and keeps earning.
